title: Balls of steel… and he can't even see red 🐂
caption:
The red cape is a lie. Bulls are red-green colourblind 🐂🟥
Tag someone who still believes it 👇
first_comment: Did you think bulls hate red? 🐂👇
sources: Jacobs G. H., Deegan J. F., Neitz J. (1998) 'Photopigment basis for dichromatic color vision in cows, goats, and sheep', Visual Neuroscience 15: 581-584
MythBusters, 'Red Rag to a Bull' (2007): the bull charged moving flags of any colour and ignored a person standing still
Encyclopaedia Britannica, 'bullfighting' (the red muleta is tradition; it also masks blood)
